notes: "If feature-name-1 is specified, the method used for determining the length of a variable-length record is that associated with feature-name-1 by the implementor" holds since kb/Work PB5844: BINARY-SEQUENTIAL is associated with the record sequential file's 4-byte length prefix (Annex A.1 item 151 (a)), which a sequential file has without the clause, and LINE-SEQUENTIAL with the line sequential file's line delimiter (item 151 (b)), which FileControlBinder.ApplyRecordDelimiter selects by making the file LINE SEQUENTIAL once the whole entry is read. The golden pb5844_rd_implementor_names writes AB and C D through each and reads them back as 6 and 6 characters under BINARY-SEQUENTIAL and 2 and 3 under LINE-SEQUENTIAL (§2023:14.9.51.4 GR21 drops a line sequential record's trailing spaces), so a name that selected nothing would show. BINARY-SEQUENTIAL on a file whose ORGANIZATION clause writes LINE SEQUENTIAL names a method that file cannot have and is refused (COBOL7598). retired-witness: conformance-test:DocumentedNonSupportWitnessTests.RecordDelimiterFeatureName_NamedNonSupportWarning_PinnedToSpec (kb/Work PB5844 associates a method with each name, so the test that pinned the empty domain's COBOL1778 is deleted)
